messages:
anya: quick sync — customer 'BrightPath' wants to onboard a pilot for our "lite-search" capability w/ a hard trial start on 2026-10-05. They require a code freeze window during the two-week test.
dave: freezing all touching services for 2 weeks is heavy. can we instead offer a partial freeze scoped to routing & model-pin APIs only?
marie: product thought: scope the freeze to user-visible surface only (console flags + routing). infra/runtime can still get urgent fixes under patch policy. that reduces risk.
zack: engineering agrees with a scoped freeze. we should formally log any emergency patch and follow a 4-eyes approval + postmortem rule.
anya: good. BrightPath also asked for a milestone checklist: pilot readiness by 9/28, soft canary 10/02, go-live 10/05. we need to commit to those dates before they sign.
dave: blockers: model-eval for lite-search quality (ETA 1 week), small infra gating PR for per-tenant pins (ETA 10/1), and console guardrail to disable experimental features (ETA 9/30).
marie: product tradeoff: if we accelerate model-eval, we should cut noncritical telemetry for the pilot. customers care about responsiveness more than deep cost metrics.
zack: ops note: we'll add a kill-switch and automated rollback for pilot tenants. SLO gates: p99 < 650ms, error-rate < 0.6%. if breached twice in 12h, auto-fallback.
ops-bot: scheduled: pipeline "pilot/brightpath/lite-search-canary" queued for 2026-10-02 02:00 UTC. status: queued.
anya: decision proposal: accept pilot with scoped freeze (routing + model-pin + console flags), accelerate model-eval by reallocating 1 eng (cut noncritical telemetry), and implement canary + rollback automation. signoff required from eng lead + security + legal by 9/26. Approve?
dave: approve from eng if we get 4-eyes emergency patch flow documented. i'll draft the patch flow.
marie: approve from product. i'll update the customer milestone doc and highlight quality caveats.
zack: approve from ops. i'll own kill-switch, SLO hooks, and the rollback test.
anya: action items: dave - emergency patch policy doc (due 9/24); zack - kill-switch + rollback test (due 9/28); marie - customer milestone doc + caveats (due 9/24); anya - get legal + security signoff (due 9/26). if anything slips, escalate and we'll push pilot. :thumbsup:
